The first ever CLAUDE MADE ANIME is out!!

It's called Gus & Spark and 25 minute episode. Opus 5.5 MAX worked on it for over 15 hours, and wrote it code by code with 0 AI generated video.

- 34K lines of code
- 986M tokens, about $370 at API prices

I believe Fable 5.5 should be able to produce even higher quality anime! 

In the future all 3D animated videos can be created by Claude without any AI generated video.
